description: This file defines the NotebookItemModel class, which manages interactions with notebook items in the Notesnook application, including opening, editing, creating subnotebooks, moving to trash, pinning, shortcuts, and visibility controls.

classes.name: NotebookItemModel
classes.description: Model class for interacting with notebook items in the UI, providing methods for common actions like opening, editing, pinning, and moving notebooks.

methods.name: openNotebook
methods.description: Opens the notebook and returns a NotesViewModel instance.

methods.name: editNotebook
methods.description: Opens the context menu and initiates editing of the specified notebook.

methods.name: createSubnotebook
methods.description: Creates a subnotebook under the current notebook.

methods.name: moveToTrash
methods.description: Moves the notebook to trash, optionally deleting contained notes.

methods.name: isPinned
methods.description: Checks if the notebook is pinned.

methods.name: createShortcut
methods.description: Creates a shortcut for the notebook.

methods.name: removeShortcut
methods.description: Removes the shortcut for the notebook.

methods.name: isShortcut
methods.description: Checks if the notebook has a shortcut.

methods.name: isMoveToTopVisible
methods.description: Checks if the 'Move to Top' menu option is visible.
